sections.title: Form and range
sections.text: A small hairy annual, prostrate or ascending, native to tropical regions and now widespread in warm climates. Its stems can reach 50 cm.

sections.title: Leaves and flowers
sections.text: The opposite leaves are about 1–4 cm long. Tiny cyathia cluster in the leaf axils; the capsule is only about 1–1.5 mm long.

sections.title: Toxicity
sections.text: The latex is irritating; eye exposure can be serious and ingestion can cause digestive illness. Traditional uses do not establish safety.
